answers.genPolicy:aa783572ad42b3ba21407882e715e7:
[B1] < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > $ UserX 'approach' deviceA
=> < UserX | 'near' : deviceA , ... > .
[B2] < UserX | 'near' : deviceA , ... > $ UserX 'leave' deviceA
=> < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > .
[B3] < cloudA | 'key' : 'secret' , deviceA : ('users' : (UserX) , ...) , ... > < RelayUser | 'near' : deviceA , ... > $ UserX 'shareAccess' cloudA | UserY
=> < cloudA | 'key' : 'secret' , deviceA : ('users' : (UserX , UserY) , ...) , ... > < RelayUser | 'near' : deviceA , ... > $ cloudA 'proxy' RelayUser | (deviceA ; list(encrypt('auth', 'secret') ; 'share' ; UserY)) .
[B4] < cloudA | 'key' : 'secret' , deviceA : ('users' : (UserX , UserY , Rest) , ...) , ... > < RelayUser | 'near' : deviceA , ... > $ UserX 'revokeAccess' cloudA | UserY
=> < cloudA | 'key' : 'secret' , deviceA : ('users' : (UserX) , ...) , ... > < RelayUser | 'near' : deviceA , ... > $ cloudA 'proxy' RelayUser | (deviceA ; list(encrypt('auth', 'secret') ; 'revoke' ; UserY)) .
[B5] < ImmediateRelayUser | 'near' : deviceA , ... > $ cloudA 'proxy' RelayUser | (deviceA ; L)
=> < ImmediateRelayUser | 'near' : deviceA , ... > $ RelayUser 'forward' deviceA | L .
[B6] < CachingRelayUser | 'near' : deviceA , 'cache' : nils , ... > $ cloudA 'proxy' RelayUser | (deviceA ; L)
=> < CachingRelayUser | 'near' : deviceA , 'cache' : L , ... > .
[B7] < CachingRelayUser | 'near' : deviceA , 'cache' : L , ... >
=> < CachingRelayUser | 'near' : deviceA , 'cache' : nils , ... > $ CachingRelayUser 'forward' deviceA | L .
[B8] < deviceA | 'users' : Users , ... > $ RelayUser 'forward' deviceA | list(encrypt('auth', 'secret') ; 'share' ; UserY)
=> < deviceA | 'users' : (Users , UserY) , ... > .
[B9] < deviceA | 'users' : (UserY , Rest) , ... > $ RelayUser 'forward' deviceA | list(encrypt('auth', 'secret') ; 'revoke' ; UserY)
=> < deviceA | 'users' : Rest , ... > .
